name: Numajiri
source:
One of the three most feared staff members in the hospital. She criticizes even the slightest mistake and endlessly harasses the others with her sarcasm. 

She loves to bully the weak and see them cry because they can't take it anymore. She is thinking of keeping Yamada as her pet.

[From [url=https://nexton-net.jp/ms-toybox/darkone/sakuseibyoto3/character/index.html]official site[/url]]
